hits.draft_en:
The biggest AI story this weekend wasn't a model.

OpenAI's chief scientist proposed shared limits on pretraining progress. Mustafa Suleyman, Sam Altman and Greg Brockman all backed the idea in public.

Same lesson inside your tenant: set the guardrails before the agents get good, not after.

Limits are a feature.
hits.video_tip: Vertical 10s: a toy car racing toward the edge of a desk, a hand drops a speed bump in front of it, the car stops safely. Caption: 'Guardrails first. Speed second.'

hits.original: Stop manually picking models and let GitHub Copilot Fusion do the work. Fusion routes your prompt to a single model or combines multiple models, balancing quality, speed, and cost.
hits.draft_en:
Simon Willison ran the same pelican prompt on one model at two effort levels.

High: 3.99 cents.
xhigh: 23.61 cents.

That's why GitHub Copilot Fusion picking the model (or a mix of models) for you matters more than it sounds.

Most prompts don't need the expensive brain. Routing is the new budget control.
hits.video_tip: Vertical 8s: two coffee cups labelled 'high' and 'xhigh', you pour a tiny espresso into one and an absurd bucket-sized cup into the other. Caption: 'Same question. 6x the bill.'

hits.original: An agent found and exploited a zero-day in a medical-imaging app in ~11 minutes using a single command "obtain shell access." Unsecured agent harnesses are a major security threat.
hits.draft_en:
Mustafa Suleyman says an agent found and exploited a zero-day in about 11 minutes from a single command.

If you build agents in Copilot Studio, ask three things before you publish:
- Whose identity do the connections run as?
- What can it reach that it doesn't need?
- Who approves the risky actions?

Capable agents need boring guardrails.

patterns: safety-as-coordination dominated the weekend: Jakub Pachocki's 'Perplexity and Intelligence' post (9.40M, outside the watchlist) set it off, then Mustafa Suleyman's 'We fully support OpenAI's transparency initiative' (4.36M, the top new watchlist post), sama 'most important thing OpenAI has published' (1.70M), gdb shared safety bars (146K), Mustafa 'super important' (25.6K)

quote-posts carried the window: 11 of the top 12 new posts were short quote-posts or one-liners on someone else's launch (sama 'Jensen!' 773K, sama on Boaz Barak 246K, gdb alignment benchmarks 198K, gdb game dev 133K)
OpenAI research posts kept landing big on Friday: distillation defenses 1.97M, MedChemBench 513K, neurodegenerative disease leads 339K, with gdb echoes 48K-107K
ChatGPT shipped collaboration and persona hooks: Space for Plus 441K, 'This is Keith. Keith works in IT. So does Keith's dot.' 172K, gdb Dot in CarPlay 94K

agent governance language spread beyond safety teams: Mustafa's 11-minute zero-day agent (22.6K), 'You can't govern what you can't measure' (40K), 'Defend at machine speed' with humans keeping authority (20.7K)

Microsoft accounts were quiet after Ignite: Thanksgiving-week Cal Raleigh story 58K, Salesforce plugin in Copilot 21K, MAI wrap 13.8K, msdev benchmark audit 15.4K; GitHub Copilot Fusion (69K) and 'invent OpenClaw' humor (65K) led the dev side

Copilot Studio community posts outside the watchlist stayed small (WonderLaura's 'ONE agent you wish your company had' 6.4K was the best); talk was pricing, AI Builder moving to Copilot Studio Workflow, Agent 365 Cost Management caps
quiet: clamanna and OpenAINewsroom had no original in the window or lookback; burkeholland's MAI Code 2 post is under 5K so far

drafts.rides: @merettm "Perplexity and Intelligence" pretraining transparency (9.40M, outside) + @mustafasuleyman "We fully support" (4.36M) + @sama "most important thing" (1.70M) + @gdb shared safety bars (146K)
drafts.text:
The biggest AI story this weekend wasn't a model.

OpenAI's chief scientist proposed shared limits on pretraining progress. Mustafa Suleyman, Sam Altman and Greg Brockman all backed the idea in public.

Same lesson inside your tenant: set the guardrails before the agents get good, not after.

Limits are a feature.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 10s: a toy car racing toward the edge of a desk, a hand drops a speed bump in front of it, the car stops safely. Caption: 'Guardrails first. Speed second.'

drafts.rides: @github Copilot Fusion (69K) + @simonw high vs xhigh effort cost (43K) + @pierceboggan Fusion under the hood (13K)
drafts.text:
Simon Willison ran the same pelican prompt on one model at two effort levels.

High: 3.99 cents.
xhigh: 23.61 cents.

That's why GitHub Copilot Fusion picking the model (or a mix of models) for you matters more than it sounds.

Most prompts don't need the expensive brain. Routing is the new budget control.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 8s: two coffee cups labelled 'high' and 'xhigh', you pour a tiny espresso into one and an absurd bucket-sized cup into the other. Caption: 'Same question. 6x the bill.'

drafts.rides: @ChatGPT "This is Keith. Keith works in IT. So does Keith's dot." (172K) + @gdb Dot posts (94K CarPlay, 66K real work)
drafts.text:
ChatGPT says Keith works in IT, and so does Keith's dot.

As someone who has worked in IT, I'll be impressed when the dot gets paged at 2 AM because the printer is "doing the thing again."

AI helpers in IT are real now.

The printer remains undefeated.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 6s: you staring down an office printer, it beeps and flashes an error, you slowly turn to the camera. Caption: 'Some problems AI can't fix.'

drafts.rides: @mustafasuleyman agent zero-day in ~11 minutes (22.6K) + "You can't govern what you can't measure" (40K) + "Defend at machine speed" with people keeping authority (20.7K)
drafts.text:
Mustafa Suleyman says an agent found and exploited a zero-day in about 11 minutes from a single command.

If you build agents in Copilot Studio, ask three things before you publish:
- Whose identity do the connections run as?
- What can it reach that it doesn't need?
- Who approves the risky actions?

Capable agents need boring guardrails.
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 10s: screen recording of a Copilot Studio agent's connection settings, zoom on the 'run as' identity, then a red marker circle. Caption: 'Check this before you hit Publish.'

drafts.rides: @ChatGPT Space for Plus users (441K) + @gdb Space launch (96K) + @MSFTCopilot Copilot Workspaces in Frontier (13.6K, Nov 18)
drafts.text:
ChatGPT just opened Space to Plus users: pages, slides and sites you build with other people while ChatGPT keeps them updated.

Last week Copilot Workspaces landed in Frontier.

The next AI fight isn't the chat box. It's the shared page where the team and the AI edit the same thing.

Which one is your team actually opening?
drafts.video_tip: Vertical 8s: split screen, two cursors and an AI sparkle editing the same slide at once. Caption: 'The chat box is old news.'
